critique: Palette restored — teal-cyan specks on plum-violet, both neon hues present, moody and cohesive. But the core '密集雨丝' still fails: drops render as star-like dots; aspect 5 produced no visible vertical elongation (direction of the ratio may be inverted, or it needs size to show). Wave-warp displacement is present but sub-perceptual at dot scale.

suggestions.why: if aspect is width/height, <1 = tall-thin particles = rain streaks (either way the direction answer feeds the ontology)
wider shutter = longer motion smear per frame
slightly larger base size makes the elongation readable
